summary: Frontend-only verification of two UI layout bug fixes on Dashboard. Logged in as admin@studylocus.com/admin123 at the preview URL, then measured Journey card (default size) and Countdown card (after shrinking via .react-resizable-handle drag). Both bug fixes are working as intended.

bug1_journey_default_size.evidence: At default card size (grid height 222px), legend row bottom=255.375 and tip text bottom=278.375 both fall within the grid item bounds (top=113.19, bottom=335.19). legendVisible=true, tipVisible=true. The heatmap grid, legend ('Upcoming','Today','Test','Exam') and tip 'Tip: click any day to plan a test on it.' are all fully rendered without clipping. .graph-container has overflow-y:auto (min-height:0) so it scrolls internally rather than pushing content out.

bug2_countdown_scales.evidence: Initial font-size of .countdown-num was 37.13px in default card (432x222). After shrinking the card to ~320x174 by dragging .react-resizable-handle inward, font-size scaled down to 24.65px. All three numbers (countdown-days=131, countdown-hours=05, countdown-minutes=52) remained fully inside the .countdown-wrap bounds with clipped=false. CSS container-query sizing (clamp(1.3rem, 26cqmin, 4.2rem)) is working correctly.

regression_login_and_dashboard.evidence: Login with admin@studylocus.com/admin123 succeeded. Dashboard rendered all 9 default cards (Countdown, Journey, My Tasks, Study Log, Welcome, Quote, Mock Test Progress, Test Planner, Daily Agenda). No page-breaking console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking console warning from react-grid-layout: 'prop minHeight larger than item height/maxHeight'. This is likely triggered by collapsed cards (h=2, maxH=2) whose minH from CARD_META (e.g., minH:4) isn't overridden until withCollapse runs. withCollapse does set minH:1 for collapsed items, so the warning most likely fires during initial layout hydration or transient state. Not caused by the two fixes; consider addressing in a follow-up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Journey card default-size layout fix and Countdown card container-query font scaling fix are verified working on preview URL. If regressions need re-check, log in as admin and measure (a) legendRect.bottom & tipRect.bottom vs journey grid-item bottom, (b) countdown-days font-size before/after dragging .react-resizable-handle inward on the Countdown react-grid-item — font should shrink and numbers must not overflow .countdown-wrap.
